segments.title: Japanese naval history beyond World War II
segments.summary: Japan's naval past extends well beyond World War II, with earlier ship designs shaped by amphibious and littoral warfare.
segments.body: Searches for Japanese naval history often narrow the subject to World War II, obscuring a much longer and more varied tradition. Earlier Japanese ship designs provide one way into that history because they were closely shaped by amphibious and littoral warfare. Their functional elegance is presented as a direct response to that operational purpose. This short reflection connects ship design with how naval forces operated in Japan's earlier maritime history.

evidence.note: He says Japanese naval history is commonly reduced to World War II and highlights earlier designs shaped by amphibious warfare.
